## Fixed-Issue Fingerprints

These are real security fixes mined from git history. Use them as regression checks.

- **Request Smuggling** (high) [CWE-444]: Preserves absolute request targets in unsafe raw requests, preventing potential request smuggling or SSRF by not rewriting the request line.
  - sink: `rawrequest.UnsafeRawBytes`
  - fix: preserve absolute request target in unsafe raw bytes
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/1027207f5e0ccc93f7e8713fff82d80b9f44aa90 (2026-08-11)
- **Authentication Bypass** (high) [CWE-347]: Fixes a cache poisoning vulnerability where mtime-based cache reuse could allow unsigned/tampered templates to bypass signature verification and execute.
  - sink: `LoadTemplatesWithTags, Parse, cacheValidatedMetadata`
  - fix: Content-based verification binding (ContentDigest, VerifierFingerprint) and re-verification on change
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/9de96e4dda5a03da963b9ae6582f03ea55791a76 (2026-08-04)
- **Access Control Bypass** (medium) [CWE-284]: Fixes a filter bypass where IncludeTags could force-include templates that were explicitly excluded by other criteria.
  - sink: `isForcedInclude`
  - fix: include-tags only cancels exclusion for the same tag; other filters still apply
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/6d81cc3b62f304049c759c53a760a1c41ab04e8a (2026-07-23)
- **Cryptographic Misuse** (medium) [CWE-347]: Fixes ECDSA public key encoding to avoid deprecated coordinate access and ensures proper error handling.
  - sink: `publicKey.Bytes()`
  - fix: Use proper key encoding and error propagation
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/bcd580703dbc149b8adce3729d45733cbb866364 (2026-07-15)
- **Code Execution** (high) [CWE-94]: Enforces signature verification for JavaScript templates, preventing execution of unsigned malicious templates.
  - sink: `Signature check`
  - fix: Requires signatures for javascript templates
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/fac0b7196d2fbca56c8af8ff8e1899c111041a37 (2026-07-03)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-22]: Enforces file sandbox for krbforge output, preventing arbitrary file writes.
  - sink: `OutputFile`
  - fix: Path sandboxing for output file
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/3a8b65cb45f121fcdf418f60e5177ed9f250c122 (2026-06-24)
- **SSRF** (high) [CWE-918]: Adds IsHostAllowed check before LDAP dialing to enforce network policy and prevent SSRF.
  - sink: `dialers.Fastdialer.Dial`
  - fix: Add host allowlist check before dialing
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/9def9af7e3f7ebcf5cd561c37b623b9999ee7572 (2026-06-24)
- **Local File Inclusion** (high) [CWE-98]: Gates MySQL allowAllFiles behind the -lfa flag, preventing arbitrary file reads.
  - sink: `sql.Open`
  - fix: DSN sandboxing - drops allowAllFiles unless -lfa
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/9611926a9a1ca99e8ed554d1b26fbeff60e06368 (2026-06-19)
- **Auth Bypass** (high) [CWE-347]: Ensures unsigned code templates are rejected on all loading paths, including DAST, preventing a signature bypass that allows arbitrary code execution.
  - sink: `LoadTemplatesWithTags`
  - fix: Moved the unsigned code template check before the DAST branch
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/1c440e755a97471c56fb0276ee8a8c4132974645 (2026-06-19)
- **Path Traversal** (high) [CWE-22]: Fixes path traversal vulnerabilities by replacing lexical prefix checks with canonical path containment checks.
  - sink: `strings.HasPrefix(templatePath, dir)`
  - fix: canonical path containment checks
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/20cbf0bd73893c1270582c9778b6b26a5cb11206 (2026-06-04)
- **Code Injection** (high) [CWE-94]: Prevents unintended helper function execution during literal checks and improves error handling to prevent panics.
  - sink: `compiled.Evaluate(base)`
  - fix: avoid helper eval in literal checks; return errors
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/6c803c74d193f85f8a6d9803ce493fd302cad0eb (2026-04-10)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-284]: Enforces the local file access sandbox on the JS 'require' function, preventing unauthorized file reads and closing a cache reuse vulnerability.
  - sink: `require`
  - fix: Rebuild require registry per execution and enforce local file access sandbox
  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/6f2ade6a9b427c284c15a43445f9c7f055e60e5d (2026-04-10)
- **Information Disclosure** (medium) [CWE-200]: Fixes potential information disclosure by ensuring temporary files containing inline secrets are cleaned up.

- **Cryptographic Weakness** (high) [CWE-338]: Replacing predictable math/rand with cryptographically secure crypto/rand in Rand and RandInt functions prevents token/nonce prediction.

  - commit: https://github.com/Penguinjanator/nuclei/commit/44ef9ce34ffcfdfca3a96626abc73d99dd0e83ab (2026-03-15)
